crossRefs.note: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t…
The chief priests accused him of many things.
The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew…
They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and…
“Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will…
saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise…
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up…

translations.web: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
translations.bsb: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
translations.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
translations.asv: They answered and said unto him, If this man were not an evildoer, we should not have delivered him up unto thee.
